data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘बड़’ (bada), which means ‘great’, ‘big’, or ‘large’. This name is used in Hindu culture to signify strength, power, and size. The name Bada carries the meaning “Great, big” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bada usually hope their child will grow to embody great, big and live with faith, good character and purpose.
